annotation.title_clean: 住房城乡建设部 国家数据局关于全面建立房屋建筑统一代码制度的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and the National Data Administration on Comprehensively Establishing a Unified Building Code System
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 住房城乡建设部; 国家数据局
annotation.venue: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (建办〔2026〕32号)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and National Data Administration notice establishing a unified building code system, assigning unique IDs to buildings across their lifecycle, with data governance and security measures. Only passing mentions of AI, low-altitude economy and intelligent driving as application scenarios.
key_provisions_or_claims: Full coverage of unified codes for new buildings by end-2027; high-quality lifecycle dataset by 2030
Codes assigned before construction permits and linked to CIM platform with CGCS2000 coordinates
National, provincial and municipal building information databases to be built and interconnected
Codes mapped to credit codes, ID numbers and property units for cross-department services
Data quality control, encryption, desensitisation and security measures required
